title: objectui#9627 post-PASS residuals (4): two corrected changesets each keep one contradicting sentence that still publishes, a self-referential false claim in a parity-test header, and a PR-prose CJK inaccuracy
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat. Four residuals the **second** isolated at-tier contract review of PR objectui#9627 named as **non-blocking** (record: PR comment `5700911252`, head `f8388535d9`, VERDICT **PASS**). The verdict is adopted verbatim — ⛔ this card does not reopen it, and ⛔ none of these four is a contract defect.

Context for a reader who lands here cold: that PR went **FAIL → patch round → PASS**. The four corrections the FAIL required are done and verified. These are what the second review found *after* them, each judged and explicitly ruled not verdict-carrying.

## 1 + 2 — two corrected changesets each keep one sentence that contradicts the correction ⚠️ time-boxed

objectui#9627 corrected the prose of two pending changesets in place (the right route, ruled so). Each still carries one older sentence the new text does not reach:

- `.changeset/7129-retire-detailviewsection-hideempty.md` — still reads *"an authored `hideEmpty` of either polarity is now inert, and the release notes should read that way"*. The inserted supersession note says "the paragraphs **above**", so it does not cover this one, and the corrected Migration paragraph two below it says the opposite.
- `.changeset/7064-empty-section-default.md` — still closes with *"No application metadata needs editing — that is the point of the change"*, now only framed by the new header paragraph rather than corrected.

⚠️ **Both publish verbatim into the CHANGELOG**, in the same release as objectui#9627's own entry. The window closes when release PR objectui#5400 merges. Same class as objectui#9625 and objectui#9528.

⭐ Neither is an instruction a consumer performs (which is why the review ruled them non-blocking — the one that *was* such an instruction was fixed in the patch round), and both entries do now state what ships. A one-line touch on each closes it.

## 3 — a self-referential sentence that is false about its own file

`packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/recordDetailsInputs.spec-parity.test.ts`. The patch round rewrote this header to stop asserting a stale fact about `showBorder`. The rewrite works, but the header now says:

> Neither fact is written down as a verdict anywhere in this file

…while the same header **does** write both down (`title` is refused by the installed spec, `showBorder` is declared by it), hedged with "today", and the body comment repeats them. Both statements are true at 17.4.0 and are derived per run, so ⛔ the contract is not affected — the only false sentence is the one claiming they are not written down.

## 4 — PR prose inaccurate about its own CJK handling

The objectui#9627 body says pre-existing non-English strings in the touched files are left alone. For `record-details.hideEmptyRetired-7129.test.tsx` that is not what the diff does: 2 pre-existing lines were converted to English there. ⭐ The conversion itself is correct (AGENTS.md commandment #-1, English-only codebase) — ⛔ do not revert it. Only the PR body's account of it is wrong, and that body is not a published surface, so this is the lowest-value of the four. Recorded for completeness rather than because it costs anything.

## Also recommended by the same review, ⛔ NOT part of this card

`packages/plugin-detail` declares `@objectstack/spec` at `^17.1.0` while its four-party pin asserts a key the spec declares only from 17.3.0 (`packages/types` already declares `^17.4.0`). Pre-existing, outside objectui#9627's diff, and `check:spec-floors` is the instrument that owns it. It wants its own card if anyone picks it up.

## Boundaries

- ⛔ Do not touch the restoration itself, the default's placement, the edit-mode gate, or any pin assertion. The review ruled all of them right, twice.
- ⛔ Do not change either changeset's frontmatter or declared packages — prose only. `check-changeset-overwrite` records such an edit under its own case 2, which is the intended shape.

## State

`pm:queue`. ⛔ No blocker: PR objectui#9627 is already cleared, ready and enqueued, so items 1–3 are reachable as soon as it lands. Item 1/2's **window** is the thing to watch, not a dependency.
